adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
ORTHOPEDICS — 12/27/2024
27 y/o M, left shoulder pain lifting overhead at the gym. Vitals: Wt 93.5 kg, BMI 35.2, BP 128/84.
Positive impingement signs, strength intact.
Dx: left shoulder impingement. Subacromial injection; home exercise program for rotator cuff daily; avoid overhead pressing for 4 weeks.

PHYSICAL THERAPY — 03/14/2025
Mechanical low back pain after moving furniture, 3 weeks; no radicular signs.
Plan of care: 6 visits; core stabilization home exercise program daily; lifting mechanics.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 04/12/2026
S: 28 y/o M, BP and weight follow-up. Says he is "trying to eat better and be more active." Works long hours; reflux controlled.
O: Wt 93.0 kg, Ht 163 cm, BMI 35.0. BP 136/82.

A/P:
1. Obesity — encouraged; revisit at next visit.
2. Hypertension: BP 136/82 on amlodipine 5 mg daily; continue, home log.
3. GERD — stable on omeprazole.

Date: 08/07/2026
S: 28 y/o M, weight and BP follow-up. Lifestyle: "doing what he can" with food choices; busy schedule; some walking. Weight 93.0 kg, not much change. Asks about Wegovy.
Medications: states he was on "a weight-loss shot" through a telehealth service; not sure whether he is still taking it or what it was — will check and call back.
No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 93.0 kg, BMI 35.0. BP 126/84.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 35.0 — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Will confirm telehealth medication before starting. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hypertension: BP 126/84 on amlodipine 5 mg daily; continue.
